answers.workaround:
It is possible to use the scroll bar
update:
```gdscript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin

var inspector: EditorInspector
var v_scroll_bar: VScrollBar
var current_scroll_value: float
var scroll_duration: int
var scroll_factor: float = 0.025

func _enter_tree() -> void:
	inspector = EditorInterface.get_inspector()
	v_scroll_bar = inspector.get_v_scroll_bar()
	inspector.gui_input.connect(_on_inspector_gui_input)

func _exit_tree() -> void:
	inspector.gui_input.disconnect(_on_inspector_gui_input)
	v_scroll_bar = null
	inspector = null

func _on_inspector_gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not event is InputEventMouse:
		return
	
	var input_event_mouse: InputEventMouse = event
	if input_event_mouse.button_mask != MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_MIDDLE:
		return
	
	var viewport_size = inspector.get_viewport_rect().size
	var screen_width = viewport_size.x
	var screen_height = viewport_size.y
	var mouse_position = inspector.get_global_mouse_position()
	var new_mouse_position = mouse_position

	if mouse_position.x < 0:
		new_mouse_position.x = screen_width
	elif mouse_position.x >= screen_width:
		new_mouse_position.x = 0

	if mouse_position.y < 0:
		new_mouse_position.y = screen_height
	elif mouse_position.y >= screen_height:
		new_mouse_position.y = 0

	if new_mouse_position != mouse_position:
		Input.warp_mouse(new_mouse_position)
	
	if current_scroll_value < input_event_mouse.global_position.y:
		current_scroll_value = input_event_mouse.global_position.y
		scroll_duration = -1
	elif current_scroll_value > input_event_mouse.global_position.y:
		current_scroll_value = input_event_mouse.global_position.y
		scroll_duration = 1
	
	inspector.scroll_vertical += scroll_duration * (current_scroll_value * scroll_factor)

```
